mutation.note: removing the bounded-fiber hypothesis makes ess sup nu_x grow with n

reason: The bofop condition ess sup_x nu_x(Omega) < infinity is reproduced as a log-log growth exponent over an n-sweep: the bounded-degree (sparse) family has exponent ~0 with fiber sup pinned at 4 for every n, while dense ER (exponent ~1) and a single sqrt(n) hub (exponent ~0.5) are excluded. This shows the definition genuinely discriminates a sparse subclass inside the graphop class. No numeric value is stated in the paper to match.
